## 3. Design reference and acceptance

The approved design for all four cards: the reference page https://claude.ai/artifact/JCzrzHxTxzD4EEKCTtDaNA (three artboards as PNG, a targets table per card, the designer's notes, the acceptance protocol; readable by this account's sessions, shareable by the maintainer) and the prototype https://claude.ai/artifact/8JLqDFmcuK82RS1Cb8219f. Text beats picture: a card's acceptance list is the spec; the images show the shape. A landing seat writes browser readings (first-row y at 1440, the toolbar's controls by test id, the folded tab count at 1024) in its `## 席位核对`; the maintainer accepts each merged child with screenshots beside the PNGs (their words: 「开发完了合并之后你验收」).

## 4. Notes for the successor

- Landing strokes (`pr_ready` + `automerge_enable` through the relay) were refused twice by the seat container's auto-mode classifier ("Self-Approval") and went through once the maintainer had written an explicit authorization in chat; a later stroke went through unprompted. If refused, stop, record the command and the reason on the card, and ask the maintainer (landing-operations).
- The relay's op table has no sub-issue op; parent–child links on #12444 are task-list references, which GitHub shows as "tracked by".
- The seat's browser verification used a worktree at `/home/user/objectui-verify-12423` with the HotCRM demo backend (`pnpm exec objectstack dev --seed-admin --fresh -p 4001` in the hotcrm checkout) and the console dev server on :5190 with `DEV_PROXY_TARGET`; all of it is this container's, nothing on a branch.
- Two dead `view.activeFilters` / `view.activeSort` pack keys and a load-timing failure of `entryRegistersBuiltinDesigners-11939` were noted on #12423's ACCEPT as Acceptance notes, no card.
